points.title: 贵族童年
points.description: 屠格涅夫出生于奥廖尔省一个富裕的贵族家庭。他的父亲是退役军官，母亲瓦西里耶夫娜是一位专横的女地主。童年时期，屠格涅夫在家族庄园斯帕斯科耶度过，这里的环境深刻影响了他后来的创作。他从小接受良好的教育，但家庭关系紧张，特别是与母亲的关系复杂。这段经历使他后来在作品中经常描绘贵族与农民之间的矛盾，以及对女性命运的思考。
points.descriptionEn: Turgenev was born in Oryol Province to a wealthy noble family. His father was a retired officer, and his mother, Varvara Petrovna, was an autocratic landowner. During his childhood, Turgenev lived at the family estate of Spasskoye, an environment that profoundly influenced his later writings. He received an excellent education but experienced tense family relations, particularly with his mother. This period shaped his later focus on the contradictions between nobles and peasants, and on the fate of women in his works.

points.title: 大学启蒙
points.description: 1833年，屠格涅夫进入莫斯科大学学习古典文学和哲学。在这里，他接触到了西方思想，特别是启蒙运动和浪漫主义文学的影响。1834年，他转入圣彼得堡大学继续学习，1837年毕业。大学期间，他开始尝试写作诗歌和散文，并结识了当时著名的文学批评家别林斯基，这段友谊对他后来的文学道路产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1833, Turgenev entered Moscow University to study classical literature and philosophy. There, he was exposed to Western thought, particularly the influence of the Enlightenment and Romantic literature. In 1834, he transferred to St. Petersburg University, graduating in 1837. During his university years, he began writing poetry and prose and met the famous literary critic Vissarion Belinsky, a friendship that profoundly influenced his later literary career.

points.title: 欧洲求学
points.description: 1838年，屠格涅夫前往德国柏林大学学习哲学和古典语言。在柏林，他深入研究了黑格尔哲学，接触了欧洲自由主义思想，这使他形成了对俄罗斯与西方关系的独特见解。同时，他游历了欧洲多个国家，特别是法国，这些经历丰富了他的视野，也使他在后来的作品中经常描绘欧洲知识分子的形象。这段时期，他开始创作短篇小说，并形成了自己独特的文学风格。
points.descriptionEn: In 1838, Turgenev went to the University of Berlin to study philosophy and classical languages. In Berlin, he deeply studied Hegelian philosophy and encountered European liberal ideas, which shaped his unique perspective on the relationship between Russia and the West. He also traveled to multiple European countries, particularly France, experiences that broadened his horizons and later influenced his frequent depiction of European intellectuals in his works. During this period, he began writing short stories and developed his distinctive literary style.

points.title: 文学生涯起步
points.description: 1843年，屠格涅夫回到俄罗斯，开始在圣彼得堡的文学圈活跃。他创作了诗歌《帕拉莎》和《地主》，并开始与别林斯基等人合作。1847年，他在《现代人》杂志上发表了他的第一篇著名短篇小说《猎人日记》，这部作品通过猎人的视角描绘了俄罗斯农村的生活和农民的苦难，引起了巨大反响。1852年，他创作了中篇小说《木木》，进一步展现了他对底层人民的同情。这一时期，他确立了作为现实主义作家的地位，并开始创作他的代表作《父与子》。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Russia in 1843, Turgenev became active in St. Petersburg's literary circles. He wrote poems such as 'Parasha' and 'The Landowner' and began collaborating with figures like Belinsky. In 1847, he published his famous short story 'A Sportsman's Sketches' in the journal 'The Contemporary,' which depicted Russian rural life and peasants' suffering through a hunter's perspective, causing a huge sensation. In 1852, he wrote the novella 'Mumu,' further demonstrating his sympathy for the lower classes. During this period, he established himself as a realist writer and began working on his masterpiece 'Fathers and Sons.'

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 1856年，屠格涅夫移居巴黎，这是他创作生涯的巅峰时期。1859年，他的代表作《父与子》出版，这部小说通过两代人之间的冲突，反映了19世纪中叶俄罗斯社会的思想变革，特别是自由主义与虚无主义的对立。1860年，他创作了《烟》，进一步探讨了俄罗斯知识分子的命运。在巴黎，他与法国作家如福楼拜、莫泊桑等人交往密切，这些国际交流丰富了他的创作视野。同时，他密切关注俄罗斯的社会变革，特别是1861年农奴制改革，这些经历都反映在他的作品中。
points.descriptionEn: In 1856, Turgenev moved to Paris, marking the peak of his creative career. In 1859, his masterpiece 'Fathers and Sons' was published, which reflected the ideological changes in mid-19th century Russian society through the conflict between generations, particularly the opposition between liberalism and nihilism. In 1860, he wrote 'Smoke,' further exploring the fate of Russian intellectuals. In Paris, he maintained close relationships with French writers such as Flaubert and Maupassant, and these international exchanges enriched his creative perspective. He also closely observed Russian social changes, particularly the 1861 serfdom reform, all of which were reflected in his works.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 1862年后，屠格涅夫主要居住在德国巴德洪堡，但仍频繁往返于俄罗斯和欧洲之间。这一时期，他创作了《烟》(1867)、《处女地》(1877)等重要作品，继续探讨俄罗斯知识分子的社会角色和使命。1870年代，他开始创作回忆录《文学与生活》，总结自己的文学创作经验。1883年，屠格涅夫在巴黎逝世，后被安葬在圣彼得堡的沃尔科沃公墓。他的晚年作品虽然不如早期那样具有革命性，但更加成熟和深刻，展现了他对人类命运的深刻思考和对艺术的执着追求。
points.descriptionEn: After 1862, Turgenev mainly lived in Baden-Baden, Germany, but frequently traveled between Russia and Europe. During this period, he wrote important works such as 'Smoke' (1867) and 'Virgin Soil' (1877), continuing to explore the social role and mission of Russian intellectuals. In the 1870s, he began writing his memoirs 'Literature and Life,' summarizing his literary experiences. Turgenev died in Paris in 1883 and was later buried in Volkovo Cemetery in St. Petersburg. His later works, though less revolutionary than his early ones, were more mature and profound, reflecting his deep thinking on human destiny and his unwavering pursuit of art.

supporter.zh: 屠格涅夫被誉为俄罗斯现实主义文学的巨匠，他的作品深刻揭示了19世纪俄罗斯社会的矛盾与变革。通过《猎人日记》等作品，他勇敢地揭露了农奴制的残酷，为农奴解放做出了重要贡献。他的小说《父与子》精准捕捉了时代变革中的思想冲突，成为俄国文学史上的经典。屠格涅夫以其精湛的艺术技巧和对人性的深刻洞察，创造了众多令人难忘的文学形象，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Turgenev is hailed as a master of Russian realist literature, whose works profoundly revealed the contradictions and transformations of 19th-century Russian society. Through works like 'A Sportsman's Sketches,' he bravely exposed the cruelty of serfdom, making significant contributions to the emancipation of serfs. His novel 'Fathers and Sons' accurately captured the ideological conflicts of an era in transition, becoming a classic in Russian literary history. With his exquisite artistic skills and profound insight into human nature, Turgenev created numerous unforgettable literary characters that have had a far-reaching influence on later literature.

critic.zh: 批评者认为屠格涅夫的作品存在明显的局限性，他过于关注贵族知识分子的生活，而对广大农民的真实处境描写不够深入。在政治立场上，他被批评为温和的自由主义者，缺乏革命性，未能真正推动社会变革。此外，他的女性形象塑造也受到质疑，常被批评为理想化或刻板化。一些评论家还指出，屠格涅夫对西方文化的过度崇拜使他未能充分理解俄罗斯民族精神的独特性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Turgenev's works have significant limitations, as he focused excessively on the lives of noble intellectuals while failing to deeply portray the real conditions of the broader peasantry. Politically, he is criticized as a moderate liberal lacking revolutionary fervor and failing to truly promote social change. Additionally, his portrayal of female characters has been questioned, often criticized as idealized or stereotyped. Some commentators also note that Turgenev's excessive admiration for Western culture prevented him from fully understanding the uniqueness of the Russian national spirit.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，屠格涅夫被视为连接俄罗斯与西方文化的桥梁人物。他的作品不仅是文学经典，也是研究19世纪俄罗斯社会思想史的重要资料。屠格涅夫创造的'多余人'形象已成为文学批评中的经典术语，而《父与子》中的巴扎罗夫则成为虚无主义者的象征。在当代，他的作品被广泛翻译和研究，影响跨越国界。屠格涅夫的文学遗产在于他既保持了俄罗斯文学的民族特色，又吸收了欧洲文学的精华，创造了独特的艺术风格。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Turgenev is regarded as a bridge figure connecting Russian and Western cultures. His works are not only literary classics but also important materials for studying the intellectual history of 19th-century Russian society. Turgenev's creation of the 'superfluous man' image has become a classic term in literary criticism, and Bazarov from 'Fathers and Sons' has become a symbol of nihilism. Today, his works are widely translated and studied, with influence that transcends national boundaries. Turgenev's literary legacy lies in his preservation of the national characteristics of Russian literature while absorbing the essence of European literature, creating a unique artistic style.

self.zh: 艺术的目的不是解决问题，而是提出问题。
self.en: The aim of art is not to solve problems, but to state them.

others.zh: 屠格涅夫是俄罗斯文学中最具欧洲气质的作家，他像一位优雅的欧洲绅士，用精致的笔触描绘了俄罗斯的灵魂。
others.en: Turgenev is the most European of Russian writers, like an elegant European gentleman who depicted the Russian soul with exquisite brushstrokes.
